testResults.name: Open TraceVault Dashboard
testResults.expectedResult: Dashboard opens with correct page title, branding, and status indicators without runtime errors.
testResults.actualResult: Dashboard loaded in 653ms. Title: 'TraceVault — Software Incident Evidence Reconstruction'. Header branding and Public Judge Mode pill visible.

testResults.name: Check Navigation & Dashboard Metrics
testResults.expectedResult: All 4 primary metric cards (Total, Active, Critical, Cryptographic Integrity SHA-256) are clearly displayed.
testResults.actualResult: Metrics verified: Total=true, Active=true, Critical=true, CryptoIntegrity=true, SHA256=true.

testResults.name: Create New Incident
testResults.expectedResult: Incident creation form accepts fields, posts to /api/incidents, and navigates to the newly allocated incident stream.
testResults.actualResult: Incident created with ID: case_6344822fd034. Redirected to http://localhost:3001/incidents/case_6344822fd034.

testResults.name: Verify Incident Details
testResults.expectedResult: Incident page displays incident title, stream ID, severity badge, and sub-navigation tabs.
testResults.actualResult: Title visible: true, Stream ID visible: true, Severity badge visible: true.

testResults.name: Navigate to Evidence Upload
testResults.expectedResult: Evidence & Sources tab opens upload dropzone with supported format guidelines.
testResults.actualResult: Dropzone visible: true. Guidelines specify JSONL, JSON, Git, CI, and ZIP archives.

testResults.name: Evidence Upload Fixture Handling
testResults.expectedResult: Fixture file is staged, uploaded to pre-ingestion validation API, and analyzed without persistence.
testResults.actualResult: Fixture staged successfully. Preview visible: true, 5 Valid: true.

testResults.name: Check Upload Validation & Pre-Ingestion Preview
testResults.expectedResult: Pre-ingestion preview displays detected adapter, valid event count, warnings, and normalized sample.
testResults.actualResult: Preview renders detected adapter, total count 5, valid count 5, and sample event JSON.

testResults.name: Confirm Evidence Ingestion
testResults.expectedResult: Clicking confirm appends events to hash chain and displays success confirmation banner with head hash.
testResults.actualResult: Ingestion confirmed: '✓ Successfully ingested 5 events into hash chain! Current head: c73aa0a177118f7f...'. Chain head updated.

testResults.name: Open Incident Timeline
testResults.expectedResult: Timeline displays all ingested events in chronological order with severity, source, and event type.
testResults.actualResult: Timeline header visible. Badge reports '7 event(s) shown'. All chained events rendered.

testResults.name: Event Filtering and Searching
testResults.expectedResult: Search input filters events by keyword (e.g. '502') and 'Clear Filters' button restores complete stream.
testResults.actualResult: Filtered text: '1 event(s) shown', Restored text: '1 event(s) shown'. Search and clear functioning deterministically.

testResults.name: Inspect Event Provenance & Metadata
testResults.expectedResult: Selecting an event card opens the Provenance Inspector displaying source system, actor, and payload.
testResults.actualResult: Provenance Inspector rendered. Source system, event name, sequence number, and raw payload accessible.

testResults.name: Verify Cryptographic Event Hashes Display
testResults.expectedResult: Inspector presents SHA-256 Previous Hash and Event Hash strings clearly.
testResults.actualResult: Previous Hash and Event Hash are present with full hexadecimal cryptographic digests.

testResults.name: Inspect Candidate Correlations
testResults.expectedResult: Overview tab renders Candidate Correlations discovered by deterministic rule engine.
testResults.actualResult: Correlation panel rendered. Identifies causal connections between deployments, errors, and auth failures.

testResults.name: Generate Deterministic Investigation Report
testResults.expectedResult: Generates 12-section investigation report with summary, audit metrics, and root cause hypothesis.
testResults.actualResult: Report generated with all 12 sections. Markdown source toggles seamlessly and reflects canonical data.

testResults.name: Test Markdown & JSON Report Exports
testResults.expectedResult: Buttons for 'Download .md' and 'Download .json' are present and responsive.
testResults.actualResult: Download .md visible: true, Download .json visible: true.

testResults.name: Export Portable Evidence Bundle
testResults.expectedResult: Exports portable bundle containing manifest, chained events, and cryptographic signatures.
testResults.actualResult: Bundle downloaded successfully (9927 bytes) to C:\Users\Atul2\OneDrive\Desktop\KiroHackethon\evidencekit\fixtures\tracevault\qa-exported-bundle.json.

testResults.name: Navigate to Independent Bundle Verifier (/verify)
testResults.expectedResult: Verifier loads with drag-and-drop bundle upload zone supporting .json and .zip formats.
testResults.actualResult: Verifier page loaded without errors.

testResults.name: Verify Valid Exported Evidence Bundle
testResults.expectedResult: Recalculates SHA-256 hash chain and confirms full cryptographic integrity (VERIFIED).
testResults.actualResult: Verification succeeded: 'Cryptographic Verification Passed' and status badge 'VERIFIED' visible.

testResults.name: Tampered Evidence Detection
testResults.expectedResult: Independent verifier detects single-bit modification and reports exact sequence breach.
testResults.actualResult: Tampering detected immediately: 'Hash chain broken at event sequence' flagged with 100% precision.

testResults.name: Invalid Upload & Malformed Format Handling
testResults.expectedResult: Corrupted, schema-violating, or invalid bundles are safely rejected with clear error messages.
testResults.actualResult: Malformed bundle safely handled without crashing. 'Integrity Discrepancy Found' visible with 9 schema errors.

testResults.actualResult: ScrollWidth > InnerWidth: false. Navigation visible: true. Timeline legible: true.
